name: Eren Deniz Kuyucaklıoğlu
lede: I study Computer Engineering in Istanbul and build products by directing AI agents. I'm drawn to the low level: processors, embedded systems, the machine's own language.
description: Eren Deniz Kuyucaklıoğlu: Computer Engineering at Yıldız Technical University, Istanbul. Products built by directing AI agents, and a record of the work.

work.title: Products I direct
work.dek: I write the specs, make the decisions and review what AI agents build. Open one to see what it is, why it exists, how it is made and what comes next.
work.byHand: Work I write myself, without agents: course problem sets, low-level experiments, contributions. It gets its own lighter format, and appears here as it happens.

log.title: The record
log.dek: What I did, why, and what I'm building. Some entries are a line, some are a few pages.
log.writingNote: I dictate the notes, often in Turkish; an agent edits them into English and I read every draft before it goes up.
log.empty: Nothing is published yet. Entries appear here as they are written, each with its date.

about.opening: I study Computer Engineering at Yıldız Technical University in Istanbul, and this is my first year. I learn the fundamentals by hand, and I build products by directing AI agents.

chapters.title: Who I am
text: I'm Eren Deniz Kuyucaklıoğlu, and I live in Istanbul. What pulls me in is whatever sits closest to the machine: processors, embedded systems, the machine's own language.

chapters.title: Where I study
text: Yıldız Technical University, YTÜ for short. I'm in my first year of Computer Engineering.
I skipped the English prep year: I passed YTÜ's prep exam with full marks.
facts: Skipped, exam passed with full marks

chapters.title: Photos
text: I take photos, mostly around Istanbul. A few of them are on this page as postcards, each beside the part it belongs to: turn one over to read the back.

photos.alt: Bostancı station platform in the rain at blue hour, the wet ground reflecting the platform lights and red signals.
photos.note: Bostancı station in the rain, at blue hour.

chapters.title: How I work
text: I work on two tracks at the same time, and they meet in everything I make.

lanes.label: With agents
items: Several agents at once, each with its own job
I write the specs and make the calls
I review what they build and tune how they work

chapters.quote: I don't stay away from AI, and I don't let it stand in for learning the basics myself.

chapters.title: At school, by hand
text: School is where most of my hand-written code comes from. Outside class I take CS50, and I write its projects myself.
There isn't much to show on this side yet. When there is, it goes here, labelled as work I wrote myself.

chapters.title: The products
text: Three products, all in active development, all built by directing agents. Each one has its own colour on this site.

chapters.title: Next
text: I'll keep studying, go further with CS50 and courses like it, and build projects alongside.
